responsibility: This file is the main expression-construction engine for the GNU Modula-2 frontend. It builds and folds GCC trees for arithmetic, logical, shift/rotate, set, comparison, pointer/address, array and component access, complex-number, literal, and SIZE operations; performs constant parsing and overflow-related checks; and provides canonical constant and size helpers, making it the central lowering layer from Modula-2 expressions to generic GCC tree IR.
same_name_distinction: Implementation file for the m2expr group: it contains the actual expression-construction, folding, constant parsing, and overflow-checking code, whereas m2expr.h is the C/C++ declaration surface and m2expr.def is the Modula-2 foreign interface for those routines.
